verdicts.explanation: The paper states LSS reaches 2.01 mS/cm at 300 K from AIMD Arrhenius extrapolation, with Ea = 0.31 eV for Li10Si2S9 in Table 2. Origin is computed in this paper.
The paper reports 0.011 mS/cm at 300 K for Li14Mn2S9 from its own AIMD work (Table 2, Ea = 0.46 eV), so the computational origin and values are correct.
Section 3.4 reports 23.7 mS/cm for the LMS/LSS-(100) interface model at 400 K from the authors' MLIP-based MD, so the value, temperature (126.85 °C) and origin match.
Section 3.4 reports 14.7 mS/cm for the LMS/LSS-(001) interface model at 400 K from the authors' MLIP-based MD, consistent with the record.
Section 3.4 reports 54.5 mS/cm for the de-LMS/LSS-(100) interface model at 400 K from the authors' MLIP-based MD, consistent with the record.
